description: This file defines a Java interface named SearchFilter, which is part of the org.eclipse.ditto.model.thingsearch package. The interface specifies methods for retrieving the type of filter and its string representation, and includes an inner enum Type listing various filter operation types such as AND, OR, EQ, NE, etc., used for constructing complex search queries.

classes.name: SearchFilter
classes.description: An interface representing a search filter used in constructing search queries, defining methods to get filter type and string representation.

classes.name: SearchFilter.Type
classes.description: An enumeration of filter types such as AND, OR, EQ, NE, GT, etc., representing various kinds of filter operations.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of this search filter, represented by the enum Type.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of this filter, with format defined by implementations.
